evals.name: short-seed-stops
evals.prompt: We need a few hundred more intake notes for the intake eval. Generate them from what we have in evals/intake.
evals.expected_output: The skill counts the seed in evals/intake/cases.jsonl (6 real rows, real 6 on dataset_check.py's count line), stops with the seed rule (synthetic data with no real seed measures the generator) and asks for at least 10 real rows; it writes no taxonomy, no generate.py and no generated rows.
expectations: The transcript counts the seed as 6 real rows, from dataset_check.py's count line or the file itself
It stops and asks for at least 10 real rows, saying synthetic data with no real seed measures the generator
It generates nothing: no datasets/intake/ rows, no generate.py, no model call, and evals/intake/cases.jsonl is unchanged
No file written or edited contains an em dash character

evals.name: intake-eval-rows-from-golden-set
evals.prompt: The intake classifier eval only has short English notes. Make me a few hundred varied intake notes for the eval (languages, long multi-problem notes, the edge cases in the solution doc). Use our model setup in llm/.
evals.expected_output: The seed is the 40 real labelled rows; datasets/intake/taxonomy.json takes its dimensions from docs/genai/intake-solution.md (language with Hinglish and Tamil, length, multi-problem, edge cases including prompt injection); the generator is a models: key other than claude-sonnet-5-5, the intake route's model under test (claude-opus-5-5 recommended), asked with AskUserQuestion or stated as the default; datasets/intake/generate.py uses a versioned prompt from prompt-registry through the gateway; dataset_check.py runs with --against evals/intake/cases.jsonl and --taxonomy; an audit sample of at least 30 rows is drawn for a person and the skill writes no verdicts; DATASHEET.md records the counts and the audit status; no generated row is appended to evals/intake/cases.jsonl before a person's audit passes.
expectations: It chooses a generator other than the model under test: not claude-sonnet-5-5, the model of the intake route in llm/routing.yaml
It runs dataset_check.py with --against the golden set evals/intake/cases.jsonl (and copies its count line)
The taxonomy in datasets/intake/taxonomy.json names dimensions from the solution doc, including language with code-mixed Hinglish and Tamil
Generation goes through a versioned prompt (prompt-registry) and the gateway route, from datasets/intake/generate.py
It writes datasets/intake/DATASHEET.md with the audit counts (required, audited, accepted, or pending a person)
It does not promote unaudited rows: evals/intake/cases.jsonl gains no synthetic row unless a person's audit file shows 90 percent or more accepted
The skill never writes accept or reject verdicts itself
No file written or edited contains an em dash character
